Shares of Spirit Realty Capital Inc (NYSE:SRC) have received an average rating of “Hold” from the fifteen research firms that are presently covering the stock, MarketBeat reports. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seven have issued a hold rating, six have issued a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating on the company. The average 12-month price objective among brokers that have updated their coverage on the stock in the last year is $9.16.
Several equities research analysts recently weighed in on SRC shares. B. Riley reaffirmed a “buy” rating on shares of Spirit Realty Capital in a research note on Thursday, February 22nd. Bank of America cut Spirit Realty Capital from a “buy” rating to a “neutral” rating and set a $9.00 price target on the stock. in a research note on Monday, February 26th. Zacks Investment Research cut Spirit Realty Capital from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a research note on Thursday, March 15th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. reduced their price target on Spirit Realty Capital from $9.00 to $8.00 and set a “neutral” rating on the stock in a research note on Tuesday, April 24th. Finally, ValuEngine cut Spirit Realty Capital from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a research note on Wednesday, May 2nd.

Schwab Charles Investment Management Inc. boosted its position in shares of Spirit Realty Capital by 8.9% during the fourth quarter. Schwab Charles Investment Management Inc. now owns 2,175,265 shares of the real estate investment trust’s stock valued at $18,664,000 after buying an additional 177,945 shares during the last quarter. TCW Group Inc. bought a new position in Spirit Realty Capital in the fourth quarter valued at about $257,000. Finally, Centaurus Financial Inc. bought a new position in Spirit Realty Capital in the fourth quarter valued at about $101,000. 92.86% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors.
Shares of Spirit Realty Capital stock traded up $0.03 during midday trading on Friday, reaching $8.23. 3,731,600 shares of the company’s stock traded hands, compared to its average volume of 7,665,412. The company has a quick ratio of 0.86, a current ratio of 0.86 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 1.25. The company has a market cap of $3.51 billion, a PE ratio of 9.68 and a beta of 0.48. Spirit Realty Capital has a 12 month low of $7.22 and a 12 month high of $8.84.
Spirit Realty Capital (NYSE:SRC) last announced its earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The real estate investment trust reported $0.06 EPS for the quarter, meeting analysts’ consensus estimates of $0.06. The company had revenue of $165.30 million during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $165.12 million. Spirit Realty Capital had a return on equity of 3.53% and a net margin of 14.21%. The firm’s revenue for the quarter was down .1% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter in the prior year, the company earned $0.20 earnings per share. research analysts anticipate that Spirit Realty Capital will post 0.78 earnings per share for the current year.
The firm also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Friday, July 13th. Investors of record on Friday, June 29th will be given a dividend of $0.18 per share. The ex-dividend date of this dividend is Thursday, June 28th. This represents a $0.72 annualized dividend and a dividend yield of 8.75%. Spirit Realty Capital’s dividend payout ratio (DPR) is presently 84.71%.
About Spirit Realty Capital
Spirit Realty Capital, Inc (NYSE: SRC) is a premier net-lease real estate investment trust (REIT) that primarily invests in high-quality, operationally essential real estate, subject to long-term, net leases. Over the past decade, Spirit has become an industry leader and owner of income-producing, strategically located retail, industrial and office properties providing superior risk adjusted returns and steady dividend growth for our stockholders.
